verdicts.proof: router.dart:175-201 lists Routes.docs in the no-auth set and not in _authRequired; the redirect (router.dart:228-259) is look-independent. Every v2 entry to /docs (profile_tiles_v2.dart:75, shell_fab_layer.dart:230 and :313, scanner context.go(Routes.docs) document_scanner_screen.dart:221/664/685) goes through the same GoRoute (router.dart:289-292) to the same DocumentsScreen, which feeds DocsViewV2 the same docsScreenStatusProvider (documents_screen.dart:39,53-54). Without a user docsVerifiedProvider returns empty (document_provider.dart:203-204) and fetchDocsGateChecklist returns null (docs_gate_provider.dart:60), so v2 _Banner shows warn 'Doklady neověřeny' (docs_view_v2.dart:238-242). Upload goes through the shared _uploadFromGallery (documents_screen.dart:61). The missing login redirect is a pre-existing gap identical in 4.1.3 (70a94933 router.dart:147,152) and in both looks.
verdicts.fix_idea: No v2-specific fix. Pre-existing gap in both looks: optionally add Routes.docs to _authRequired (affects both looks, so only with owner approval).

verdicts.proof: v2 MgAppBar receives the same onBack closure (docs_view_v2.dart:70 <- documents_screen.dart:43-49,55), MgAppBar wires it to MgV2Back (mg_app_bar.dart:54-55). System back/gesture handled by the route's MgBackGuard (router.dart:289-292) for both looks.

DocsScreenStatus/docsScreenStatusProvider (docs_gate_provider.dart:81-100) is the only status source; v2 receives the identical AsyncValue (documents_screen.dart:53-54) and derives banner (docs_view_v2.dart:224-243), cards verified/onScan (:187-202), CTA (:107-130) and codes-ready box (:155 'if (!none && v.codesReady)', same condition as v1 :242/:266) from it. No own provider or default. Note: this provider is new on the branch (not in 70a94933, which used docsVerifiedProvider and showed the green box on isComplete); both looks now use the stricter gate.

v1 documents_screen.dart:286-292 MgErrorView(eoDocsStatusFail, retry invalidates docsScreenStatusProvider). v2 docs_view_v2.dart:66-67,93-97 shows the same MgErrorView with the same key; onRetry = documents_screen.dart:63 same invalidate. On error v==null so no verified banner, no cards, no codes box (docs_view_v2.dart:73,83,98); only the full-scan CTA and gallery stay, as in v1 (v1 also keeps scan/gallery buttons).

Condition identical (v1 documents_screen.dart:101 'if (v.isComplete) return shrink'; v2 docs_view_v2.dart:77 'v != null && !v.isComplete'). v1 renders an amber bordered box with a 20px ⚠ icon (documents_screen.dart:102-117). v2 renders only one line of MgType.small text in onDarkLead colour inside the dark hero, no box, no icon (docs_view_v2.dart:78). The text itself (v2DocsRequiredInfo, translations_ext_58_v2_fix_a.dart:13 'K rezervaci motorky potřebuješ oba doklady…') is more explicit than v1's, and the warn MgStateBanner 'Doklady neověřeny' + 'Chybí: …' directly above (docs_view_v2.dart:73,238-242) still signals the block with a heading, so the block is not hidden — only this explanation lost its visual weight.
verdicts.fix_idea: In docs_view_v2.dart:77-80 render the line as a warn-tone strip (MgStateBanner tone warn or a tinted box with the warning icon) instead of plain small grey text, keeping the same condition and key.

verdicts.proof: v2 gallery button (docs_view_v2.dart:90 MgBtnGhostDark onTap: onUpload) is the only v2 gallery entry; onUpload = documents_screen.dart:61 -> _uploadFromGallery -> _processGalleryPhoto, whose offline check runs first (documents_screen.dart:367-373, _deviceOnline :425-431) with showErrorSnack + retry. Identical code for both looks.

v1 full scan button is unconditional (documents_screen.dart:152-169). v2 always shows a scan CTA in every state (docs_view_v2.dart:107-130): unknown/error/loading or nothing uploaded -> MgCta scanDocsCamera -> onScan = push Routes.docScan (documents_screen.dart:56); partly uploaded -> 'Doplnit chybějící' -> ?mode=missing; complete -> ghost 'NASKENOVAT ZNOVU' -> full scan. Missing modes are resolved by resolveDocScanPlan (doc_scan_plan.dart:36-78) with a full-flow fallback when status cannot be read (:37,:44,:55,:92-103), and all paths end in the same _finalize that re-asks get_docs_gate_checklist (document_scanner_screen.dart:633-690). Difference: in the partly-uploaded state v2 offers no full rescan of everything (only missing sides + gallery) — a flexibility difference, not a lost guard.

v1: dl_only button only when hasIdOrPassport && !hasLicense (documents_screen.dart:176,182); row scan buttons null when verified (:252,:259). v2: in that state isComplete is false and docsNothingUploaded false, so the main CTA is 'Doplnit chybějící' -> ?mode=missing (docs_view_v2.dart:122-123, documents_screen.dart:58); resolveDocScanPlan with hasIdOrPassport true gives id empty -> DocScanPlan(idType 'dl_only', only missing DL sides) (doc_scan_plan.dart:44,75), i.e. the same skip of the ID choice as dl_only, with the hint naming what will be photographed (docs_view_v2.dart:124-127). Card scan buttons are null when the document is verified (docs_view_v2.dart:192,200), same as v1; unverified DL card -> missing_dl -> idType dl_only (doc_scan_plan.dart:71-72). No side is ever counted without a photo: _finalize re-reads the server gate and warns 'docsScanIncomplete' / 'codesStillWithheld' (document_scanner_screen.dart:640-680); door codes are still decided server-side (get_docs_gate_checklist / booking_docs_gate). Missing modes return to /docs (document_scanner_screen.dart:684-685). Caveat (functional, not a guard): with one ID side already uploaded v2 forces idType 'op' (doc_scan_plan.dart:45-46,65), so a customer cannot switch to passport from the camera flow in v2 (only via gallery 'Pas'), whereas v1's row button opened the full choice.

pickGalleryDocKind (docs_gate_widgets.dart:17-36) is shared; in v2 it shows DocKindSheetV2 with the same 5 options and pops the same tuple (docs_gate_widgets.dart:29-35, doc_kind_sheet_v2.dart:25-33). The v2 sheet frame has no close action that pops a value (MgSheetFrame onClose not passed), so dismissal returns null and _uploadFromGallery returns at documents_screen.dart:341. Only v2 entry is onUpload (docs_view_v2.dart:90).
Same _uploadFromGallery for both looks (documents_screen.dart:61 for v2); picker exception -> showErrorSnack(eoGalleryOpenFail, perm: DevicePerm.photos) at documents_screen.dart:345-354.

Same _processGalleryPhoto for both looks (documents_screen.dart:61 -> :357 -> :363-417): MgProgress.show cancelAfter 20 s (:375-376), timeout 150 s (:381), abandoned upload refreshes docs when it finishes (:391-396), cancel toast r3UploadStoppedTitle (:400-402), attempt counter via onAttempt (:440-442). MgProgress is a shared widget. Note: none of this existed in 4.1.3 (70a94933 _uploadFromGallery had no offline check, no progress dialog, no kind sheet) — it is a branch improvement present in both looks.
